text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text: Well, well~! Not bad, little lamb!

text_block_list.name: Darley Arabian
text_block_list.text:
"It was a great race that brought out the 
best in her unique qualities."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it looks like she and <chrname>-chan have been 
running properly together.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
You're growing steadily as a Trainer as 
well. Take today's success to heart as 
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
And as a Trainer, you must know that from 
here on out is where the Umamusume truly 
prove themselves.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Year—battles between Umamusume 
vying for prestigious titles await.

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer's support will be more important 
than ever, so make sure you look after her 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the final race of the Junior 
Class, the "Grow-Up Race," drew to a 
close.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I had the privilege of watching both of 
the Umamusume you train run!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Despite having debuted only recently, she 
exudes such dignity and is brimming with 
confidence—

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Meek wasn't invited this time, but it 
really made me want us to participate 
together someday!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Let's take it one step at a time, without 
rushing. I'm sure she will blossom in 
time.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Both Bitter Glace and Little Cocon 
delivered great results together.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I feel like I can head 
into the Classic year with a positive 
mindset.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
My Junior year was truly fulfilling, and I 
learned so much from it as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Above all, the knowledge imparted by the 
Three Goddesses has been a constant source 
of great insight for me.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Only with an immense amount of data can 
our issues and their solutions become more 
precise.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
We also need to absorb lots of knowledge 
and become respectable trainers, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Above all else, I need to make sure I can 
properly support my trainee!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that is true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with the wisdom of the Three 
Goddesses on our side, <chrname> and I raced 
through the Junior Class.
